frameworks.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
frameworks.applicability: Voluntary engineering risk-management baseline; all six functions mapped.
frameworks.exclusions: No CSF certification or exhaustive profile implementation claimed.

frameworks.name: HIPAA Privacy, Security and Breach Notification Rules
frameworks.edition: 45 CFR Parts 160 and 164; current rules, proposed Security Rule changes tracked separately
frameworks.applicability: Assess covered entity/business associate, PHI flow, contracts and deployment jurisdiction before real-data use. Local synthetic data is not treated as real PHI.
frameworks.exclusions: Deployment-specific applicability, BAAs, legal analysis and real-data controls remain NOT_VERIFIED.

frameworks.name: FDA Clinical Decision Support Software
frameworks.applicability: Analyze each actual software function and intended use; internal A-D categories do not determine device status.
frameworks.exclusions: No FDA classification, non-device determination or clearance is generated by the engine.

frameworks.name: FDA Quality Management System Regulation
frameworks.edition: 21 CFR 820; effective 2026-02-02; ISO 13485:2016 incorporated by reference
frameworks.applicability: Applicable when a regulated finished-device manufacturer/function is in scope; maintain a separate QMS and regulatory release track.
frameworks.exclusions: Licensed ISO full text and complete QMS implementation have not been assessed. Local engineering acceptance is not QMSR compliance.

frameworks.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
frameworks.edition: AI RMF 1.0 (2023); Generative AI Profile NIST AI 600-1 (2024)
frameworks.applicability: Model/prompt/dataset versions, evaluations, monitoring and controlled promotion for AI functions. Coding worker is a development tool, never a clinical source writer.
frameworks.exclusions: No clinical model is introduced or validated in this migration; regulated AI release is NOT_AUTHORIZED.

frameworks.name: ASTP/ONC SAFER Guides
frameworks.applicability: Selected patient-identification, contingency planning, system-management and organizational-responsibility practices.
frameworks.exclusions: Automated tests do not establish site assessment, clinician usability validation or organizational conformance.

frameworks.name: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard
frameworks.applicability: Selected access control, validation, session, logging and configuration objectives with regression evidence.
frameworks.exclusions: No comprehensive ASVS level verification or penetration-test claim.

frameworks.name: OWASP API Security Top 10
frameworks.applicability: Object/function authorization, bounded inputs and resource-use controls.
frameworks.exclusions: Awareness guidance, not a complete API security certification.

frameworks.name: W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines
frameworks.applicability: Selected automated accessibility tests and responsive layout checks.
frameworks.exclusions: axe results are a subset of WCAG assessment; no full conformance or manual assistive-technology validation claimed.

frameworks.name: NIST Secure Software Development Framework
frameworks.applicability: Revision-bound evidence, dependency scanning, provenance and controlled CI execution.
frameworks.exclusions: Hosted provenance for this unpushed tree remains NOT_VERIFIED; no supply-chain certification.

csfControlObjectives.objective: Record authority, risk ownership, scoped progression and separate release decisions.
Inventory source, intended use, dependencies and open findings.
Preserve authentication, scoped access, consent, versioning and data restrictions.
Produce attributable audit decisions and failure signals.
Stop on failed gates, retain evidence, and document incident ownership.
Exercise same-file migration recovery and retest after source repairs.
